warnings: Hip trusses and jack trusses T3-T6 + single member T7 (S-24, 1/50). Spans are the printed horizontal lengths.
Conflict, decided: T7 is printed 'C-100x50x20x3.2mm' in the S-07 plan legend and 'C-100x50x20x2.3mm' here. Detail sheet wins over plan (op1 precedence 2) -> 2.3 mm; flagged on the element.
The T4 elevation labels the purlin 'C-75x37x0.75mm' while note 5 prints 'C-75x35x8.5x0.75mm@ 1.00m.' — both recorded as printed (flag on T4).
The notes block on this sheet is recorded in _view2_notes.json (structural-steel standard มอก.1228-2549; no concrete/rebar spec).
